title: prefill-decode-pipeline-chunked-speculative-stage-overlap-kernel-scheduler-optimizations
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: Reduce end-to-end latency and improve GPU utilization for mixed prefill+decode workloads by overlapping work and making prefill chunking speculative where safe. This change introduces a chunked prefill execution path, speculative prefill that inserts hot-path KV cache entries earlier, and scheduler hooks to maximize stage overlap between prefill and decode kernels. Key goals: 1) reduce p99 latency for long-context prompts, 2) increase aggregate throughput via better GPU occupancy, 3) maintain deterministic correctness and fallback behavior when speculation fails. Changes summary: implemented chunked prefill execution which breaks large prefix prefill into N sized chunks and streams KV cache inserts progressively; added speculative prefill mode that performs early KV cache placement and speculative KV lookups during decode to reduce memory stalls; extended the kernel scheduler with a stage-overlap optimizer that prioritizes interleaving prefill chunk kernels and decode kernels to keep SMs busy; optimized KV cache lock-free read path and added a lightweight eviction hint to avoid stall spikes; tightened continuous-batching heuristics to prefer slightly larger batch windows during overlap phases and added telemetry to measure overlap efficiency. Tests and validation: microbench harness shows +18% throughput for mixed 1k-token workloads, p99 latency down ~12% on our perf-canary on A100 pods, and unit/integration suites pass. Rollout plan: feature gated behind runtime flags, enabled on Canary, then +10% of production with monitoring on overlap_utilization and speculative_recovery_rate. Checklist: - [x] Implementation of chunked prefill path - [x] Speculative prefill engine with safe rollback - [x] Scheduler hooks and policy config - [x] KV cache read-path performance improvements - [x] Backwards-compatible runtime flags and fallbacks - [x] Perf canary and load test coverage - [x] Docs and config examples Notes: the description includes detailed rationale, telemetry points, and an explicit fallback path when speculation mismatches are observed.
